shell.tagline: Les artisans de la gestion immobilière

08.accent: Every insight brings it to life.

unavailable.title: Authentication not configured
unavailable.body: No identity provider is connected yet. This request was not sent and no session was created: the screens only show the planned journey.

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number for the selected country.
validation.termsRequired: You must accept the terms to create an account.
validation.summary: Fix the highlighted fields before continuing.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your Escalia workspace.
login.passwordHelp: Password rules depend on the identity provider.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: Explore the application with fictional data. No credentials are requested, nothing is saved, and this mode does not exist in production.
demo.error: The demo session could not be opened.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: A few details are enough. No role or subscription is assigned automatically.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Optional. Stored in international format (E.164) when provided. No SMS is sent.

register.passwordHelp: Password rules will be those of the identity provider.
register.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a reset link.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.linkNote: The reset link will be issued and validated by the identity provider.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.description: A verification message is sent to the address given at sign-up. Open it and follow the link to activate your account.
verify.providerNote: Sending, resending and validating the link depend on the identity provider and its contract, which are not defined yet.

sessionExpired.hint: If you had changes in progress, you will be able to redo them after signing in again.

devSignIn.title: Local sign-in (test)
devSignIn.description: Sign in as a test user of the local BFF. No password, no real data; the organization is created if needed.
devSignIn.enter: Sign in as a test user
devSignIn.error: Local sign-in failed. Is the BFF running?
